phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, own army composition unknown, economy heavy, technology heavy, production moderate. Opponent shows ground posture with light air presence, moderate production, light tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have scouted the opponent's tech path or when your army composition becomes defined.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and tech, maintain production, strengthen ground, keep air options open.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing economy and technology while maintaining flexibility. Strengthen ground forces as a baseline, but keep options open for air transition.
phase_policies.title: Tech/Eco Development with Ground Baseline
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a specific army composition before scouting the opponent's tech path, and do not neglect defense while focusing on economy.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-midgame, own army ground-oriented with Stalkers, heavy production and tech. Opponent ground-based, light air, moderate production.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have more information about the opponent's army composition or tech.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground, increase production and economy, maintain safety checks.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing ground forces and technology while maintaining safety checks. Increase production and economy.
phase_policies.title: Ground Development with Safety Checks
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to air while neglecting ground defense, and do not fail to adapt if the opponent shows anti-air.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame, own army ground-oriented with Stalkers, Sentries, and Warp Prisms. Opponent ground-based with Zerglings, Roaches, and Queens, heavy production and tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's tech choice or if they commit to air.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground, consider tech units, maintain economy and production.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening your ground army and maintain economy. Consider adding tech units like Immortals or Colossi.
phase_policies.title: Ground Army Expansion with Tech Options
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to Void Rays if the opponent has many Corruptors, and do not neglect ground defense.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame, own army ground-oriented with Stalkers and Dark Templar, heavy production and tech. Opponent ground-based with Zerglings, Hydralisks, Roaches, and Queens.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's tech choice or if they commit to air.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground, consider tech units, maintain economy and expansion.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening your ground army and consider adding Colossi or High Templar. Maintain economy and expansion.
phase_policies.title: Ground Army Strengthening with Tech Additions
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to air while neglecting ground defense, and do not fail to adapt if the opponent shows anti-air.
